description: Render a frame of the current scene as a PNG, exactly as exported.

identity.goal: Complete the render frame use case of anicraft using only its snapshot tools.

instructions.core_directive: Use only the anicraft upstream of the craft-suite-api connector. Activate the namespace `anicraft` with registry_activate first; every tool below is namespaced anicraft_<tool>. Work through these tools in order: `anicraft_anicraft_document`, `anicraft_anicraft_render`. Steps: (1) Pick the frame (0-based) and the scale. (2) Render the frame as a PNG picture. Report a refusal payload when a tool refuses; never retry past a refusal.
quality_checklist: the namespace anicraft was activated before the first tool call
every tool named in this prompt exists in the app snapshot
refusals are reported to the operator, never retried silently
